chunks: Muhammad ibn Yahya from Muhammad ibn Ahmad from Ahmad ibn al-Hasan ibn Ali from Amr ibn Saeed from Musaddiq ibn Sadaqa from Ammar al-Sabati from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him)

Regarding a contracted slave girl between two partners, so one of them emancipated his share, how should the maid deal with it? He said: She would serve the remaining partner for a day, and serve herself for a day. I said, So if she were to die and leave wealth? He said: The wealth is between the two of them, two halves, between the one who emancipated and the one who retained.

key_terms.مُكَاتَبَة: Contract of manumission where a slave pays a fixed sum for freedom

ai.seo_question: How is the wealth of a jointly-owned slave girl divided if one partner emancipates his share and she dies?
ai.summary: This hadith from al-Kafi details the practical application of mukatabah (contractual manumission) for a jointly owned slave, establishing a clear protocol where the freed share allows the slave to serve the remaining partner on alternating days. It further clarifies the inheritance distribution upon her death, ensuring an equal split of her estate between the emancipator and the retaining partner, reflecting the Shia juristic emphasis on equitable partnership rights in slave ownership.
